items.description: Jardim de Lecidere is a popular public park in Dili, providing a green space for locals to relax along the coastal promenade.
The coffee plantations in Ermera represent the heart of Timor-Leste’s traditional organic coffee production industry.
The area around the Cristo Rei statue features natural habitats for local macaque populations, visible among the coastal hills.
Maubisse is known for its high-altitude farms, which produce fresh vegetables and fruits in the cool mountain climate.
This garden is a tranquil urban spot in the capital, offering a quiet environment amidst the bustling city center.
The coastal reserve near Com offers protection to diverse marine and shore life, making it an important area for biodiversity.
The Oecusse enclave is historically renowned for its sandalwood production, which has influenced regional trade for centuries.
The rolling hills around Lospalos support traditional livestock farming, a vital part of the local eastern rural economy.
Viqueque municipality contains areas of teak forests that are managed to sustain local wood-based resources and biodiversity.
The Dili promenade is a central coastal walkway and park area, serving as a primary social gathering point for the capital city.
Same features traditional cocoa-producing smallholdings that contribute to the agricultural diversity of the Manufahi region.
The Fuiloro Plateau is an agricultural region known for its fertile soils and diverse farming activities in the east.
Mount Matebian is a prominent peak and sacred mountain in the eastern highlands, known for its challenging trekking routes.
Lake Seloi is a seasonal wetland area in the central highlands, providing an important habitat for local bird species.
Mount Mundo Perdido is famous for its unique karst topography and rich variety of endemic flora found in the high forests.
The coast near Com is defined by its dramatic cliffs and scenic beaches that characterize the eastern shoreline.
The Betano coast on the southern edge features wide, rugged beaches and strong surf, influenced by the southern seas.
